name: WF-240 — Negotiation Outcome → Contract Trigger / Rejection / Re-engagement Controller

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const action=String(d.action??d.decision??"").toLowerCase(),state=String(d.state??"").toLowerCase();const mao=Number(d.dynamic_mao??d.maximum_offer??NaN),price=Number(d.revised_offer_price??d.counteroffer_amount??d.offer_price??NaN);const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let outcome="needs_review",route="WF-126",reason="Negotiation outcome requires review.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){reason="Missing negotiation identity.";}else if(blockers.length){reason="Unresolved blockers prevent outcome routing.";}else if(["accept_counteroffer","accept_offer"].includes(action)){if(Number.isFinite(price)&&Number.isFinite(mao)&&price<=mao){outcome="contract_trigger";route="WF-241";reason="Seller agreement is within the protected dynamic MAO ceiling; contract package may be prepared.";}else{outcome="needs_review";reason="Accepted price cannot be validated against dynamic MAO.";}}else if(action==="revised_offer"){outcome="revised_offer_follow_up";route="WF-235";reason="Revised offer requires controlled seller dispatch and delivery tracking.";}else if(["rejection_reengagement","reengage"].includes(action)){outcome="rejection_reengagement";route="WF-241";reason="Seller rejection requires controlled re-engagement.";}else if(action==="walk_away_or_revised_offer"){outcome="walk_away_reengagement";route="WF-241";reason="Above-MAO negotiation requires a controlled walk-away or re-engagement path.";}else if(state==="human_review"){outcome="needs_review";route="WF-126";reason="Human review remains required before further negotiation action.";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-240",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,action,state,negotiation_outcome:outcome,route,reason,price:Number.isFinite(price)?price:null,dynamic_mao:Number.isFinite(mao)?mao:null,maO_protection:{price_within_mao:Number.isFinite(price)&&Number.isFinite(mao)?price<=mao:null,override_required:outcome==="needs_review"},requires_human_review:outcome==="needs_review"}}];
